evidence.note: A drum roller fitted with the kit for Dynamic Site Solutions; daily downtime fell from six hours to under one hour (database entry).

evidence.task: One operator supervised three retrofitted rollers: 27.33 combined hours of compaction in a 12-hour shift

openQuestions: Price on request per the database; the maker page shows no price.
name: Crewline Autonomy Kit (self-driving roller retrofit)
summary: A reversible retrofit that makes a single-drum vibratory roller or a dozer self-driving inside a geo-fenced zone, with one operator supervising several machines.

germany.statusNote: The maker (Buda, Texas) and its deployments are in the USA; no German or EU route found.
